tagline: Turn cURL commands into idiomatic Ruby — Net::HTTP or HTTParty
pageDescription: Free cURL to Ruby converter transforms cURL commands into production-ready Ruby using the Net::HTTP standard library or the popular HTTParty gem. Emits URI.parse, Net::HTTP.start block, basic_auth helper, and JSON.generate for bodies. Perfect for Rails controllers, Sidekiq workers, or plain Ruby scripts. Browser-based conversion keeps your cURL private — no server roundtrip.

proTips: Prefer Net::HTTP in gems to avoid extra dependencies
Use HTTParty in apps for readable class-based HTTP
Always wrap requests in Net::HTTP.start block for connection reuse
Set read_timeout explicitly on production calls
Never disable TLS verification in production
troubleshooting: Gem not found: add 'gem httparty' to Gemfile and bundle install
SSL handshake error: set use_ssl: true and verify_mode correctly
Body not sent: ensure request.body is set AFTER instantiating request class
JSON encoding issues: use JSON.generate, not to_json, for explicit serialization
